'''Neelo Droobas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] living on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] he tried to warn the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] about [[Frostclaw]], a giant ferocious [[Skel]] who attacked the Ortolans. However, the officials refused to believe him and Droobas was forced to ask a Republic citizen to take Frostclaw out.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neelo Droobas appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Hoth, who starts the heroic mission "Frostclaw".
